Muy buen sabor y la atencion de los mozos impecable y agradable. Entre Gaston y Martin unos grandes super macanudos y buena onda.
Volveremos a frenar en un proximo viaje!!!

(Translated by Google)
The food was delicious. We ordered the daily special, which was peppered skirt steak with noisette potatoes. We spent 35,000 pesos per person (price for the daily special, including soda). I noticed the complete mixed grill was a good price. The food was very tasty, and the waiters were impeccable and friendly. Gaston and Martin were fantastic, super friendly and easygoing. We'll definitely stop by again on our next trip!
